title: 第七章 残兵死战，以躯锁关
slug: 穿越戍边我从炮灰辅卒一路封王
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

千骑齐冲的威势，压得整片雪原狂风倒卷。

密密麻麻的黑色战马踏碎厚雪，奔行声汇成震耳的轰鸣，大地持续震颤，仿佛连残破的黑石堡墙都在跟着微微晃动。

羯族精骑并成三道横阵，层层推进，速度越来越快，杀气赤裸裸罩死整座孤堡。

墙头上仅剩的二十名残卒，人人满身血污，握着残缺兵刃的手都在发抖。

刚才击退百骑先锋，已经耗尽了他们大半力气。

此刻面对十倍不止的敌人，没人再心存侥幸，只剩直面死战的决然。

“所有人退回内墙！放弃外垛！”

苏烬沉声嘶吼，声音穿透漫天风雪。

外墙墙垛残破不堪，挡不住骑兵对冲，继续死守只会白白送命。收缩兵力，死守内墙狭小区域，才能最大程度拖延时间。

众人没有迟疑，立刻躬身后撤，快速退至内墙狭窄平台，背靠厚实墙体列成紧密横队。

周疤子手握卷刃长刀，站在最前排，胸口起伏剧烈，刀口死死对准下方冲来的骑阵：“弟兄们，活不活得了，就看这一仗！”

“跟着苏兄弟，死也值当！”陈石头咬牙攥紧断矛，哪怕手臂伤口还在渗血，也没有退缩。

其余士卒纷纷绷紧身形，原本涣散的军心，此刻彻底拧成了一股绳。

他们都是被世道、被边关磋磨的弃子，是苏烬让他们在绝境里拾起了军人的骨气。今日就算战死，也绝不跪地受戮。

堡下，羯族千骑已经冲到墙下。

穆耶策马立于阵前，冷眼盯着墙头上寥寥无几的残兵，满脸尽是讥讽。

一座破堡，二十残躯，竟敢硬生生挡他亲卫精骑。

“本王倒要看看，你们这群蝼蚁，能撑几回合。”

他抬手一挥，冷厉喝令响彻雪原：“登墙！杀光他们！寸草不留！”

话音落地，数百羯骑同时动了。

不同于之前零星袭扰，这一次，所有骑兵分散开来，围着黑石堡四面墙体同时发动强攻。

无数羯兵踩着马身腾空飞跃，借着高速冲锋的惯性，纷纷扑向墙头各个缺口。

漫天都是翻飞的黑影，寒光四起，弯刀劈砍的破风声此起彼伏。

四面同时受敌，瞬间彻底封死了残卒所有周旋空间。

“左边稳住！堵死缺口！”

“右侧有人翻上来了！快拦！”

周疤子放声怒吼，长刀疯狂劈扫，硬生生挡住两名登墙的羯兵。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The power of thousands of cavalry charging together caused the entire snowfield to be blown back by the strong wind.

The densely packed black horses trampled through the thick snow, and the sound of running merged into an ear-splitting roar. The ground continued to tremble, as if even the broken black stone fortress wall was shaking slightly.

The Jie tribe's fine cavalry formed three horizontal formations, advancing layer by layer, faster and faster, covering the entire lonely castle with naked murderous intent.

There were only twenty disabled soldiers left on the wall, all of them covered in blood, and their hands holding the incomplete weapons were trembling.

Just repelling the Hundred Cavalry Vanguard had already exhausted most of their strength.

At this moment, facing ten times more enemies, no one can take any chances anymore, only the determination to fight to the death.

"Everyone retreat to the inner wall! Abandon the outer stacks!"

Su Jin roared in a deep voice, his voice penetrating the wind and snow.

The outer walls were in dilapidated condition and could not stop the cavalry from charging. If they continued to defend, they would only lose their lives in vain.Only by shrinking the troops and sticking to the small area of ​​the inner wall can we delay the attack to the greatest extent possible.

Without hesitation, everyone immediately bowed and retreated, quickly retreating to the narrow platform on the inner wall, forming a tight line with their backs against the thick wall.

Zhou Scarzi was standing in the front row holding a long curling blade, his chest rising and falling violently, and the blade of the knife was pointed at the charging cavalry formation below: "Brothers, whether you can survive or not depends on this battle!"

"Follow Brother Su, your death will be worth it!" Chen Shitou gritted his teeth and gripped the broken spear tightly. Even though the wound on his arm was still bleeding, he did not flinch.

The rest of the soldiers tightened their posture, and their originally sluggish military morale was completely twisted into a rope at this moment.

They were all abandoned by the world and the border. It was Su Jin who allowed them to pick up the integrity of soldiers in a desperate situation.Even if I die in battle today, I will never kneel down and be killed.

Under the fort, Qianqi of the Jie tribe had already rushed to the wall.

Mu Ye rode his horse and stood in front of the formation, staring coldly at the few remaining soldiers on the wall, his face full of sarcasm.

A ruined castle and twenty broken bodies dared to stand in the way of his bodyguard's elite cavalry.

"I would like to see how many rounds you ants can last."

He raised his hand and waved, and the cold command resounded across the snowfield: "Climb the wall! Kill them all! Leave no grass behind!"

As soon as the words fell, hundreds of Jieqi moved at the same time.

Different from the previous sporadic attacks, this time, all the cavalry dispersed and launched a strong attack around the four walls of Blackstone Castle at the same time.

Countless Jie soldiers jumped into the air on their horses, and using the inertia of their high-speed charge, they rushed towards various gaps in the wall.

The sky was full of flying black shadows, cold light was everywhere, and the sound of scimitar slashing was heard one after another.

Being attacked from all sides at the same time, all the maneuvering space of the remaining soldiers was completely blocked in an instant.

"Hold on to the left! Block the gap!"

"Someone is coming up on the right side! Stop him quickly!"

Zhou Scarzi roared loudly and slashed wildly with his long knife, blocking the two Jie soldiers who were climbing the wall.
